name: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable

aliases: what kind of monster is vulgara
faq.answer: Vulgara the Insatiable is a massive, winged vuldren terrorizing the Shen'dar Highlands. Local authorities call her a scourge, and her ravenous appetite and violence endanger travelers and nearby settlements.
Constable Aonda of the local Peacekeepers issued the bounty to protect local citizens. Hunters are to bring proof of Vulgara's death to Danarii Bellowveil.
faq.q: Who placed the bounty on Vulgara?

faq.answer: Vulgara prowls a hilltop southwest of Shen'dar Village in the Shen'dar Highlands.
faq.q: Where can Vulgara the Insatiable be found?

faq.answer: Danarii Bellowveil handles the bounty's fulfillment. With bandits and cultists pressing the Peacekeepers, Danarii inspects Vulgara's severed head and dispenses the promised reward.
A vuldren is a dangerous, predatory winged beast found in the highlands. Vulgara is particularly massive and vicious, and her predation threatens local settlements.
faq.q: What kind of creature is a vuldren?

aliases: what threats are in shendar highlands
faq.answer: The Peacekeepers in the Shen'dar Highlands are stretched thin by an entrenched cult and bandits preying on local citizens. Predatory beasts like Vulgara trouble them as well.
faq.q: What other threats plague the Shen'dar Highlands?

sections.body: Constable Aonda has named Vulgara the Insatiable an immediate danger to the highlands. The massive winged vuldren roosts southwest of Shen'dar Village, where she terrorizes travelers and local settlements. The Peacekeepers call on bounty hunters to end the threat.
sections.title: The Highland Scourge

sections.body: Bandits and a shadowy cult trouble the Peacekeepers across the region. Slaying Vulgara would ease the danger to local people and keep the skies over Shen'dar safe. Then the defenders could focus on civil defense.
sections.title: Pressured Protectors

summary: In the Shen'dar Highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable terrorizes travelers and nearby settlements. Constable Aonda has called for a Peacekeeper bounty, with Vulgara's head to be brought to Danarii Bellowveil.
